title: Pseudoternary Phase Diagram Construction
author: Siriporn Okonogi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jyccpsw

steps.title: Prepare surfactant systems (Smix)
steps.instruction: Mix surfactant (Tween 20, Tween 80, or Triton X-100) and cosurfactant (absolute ethanol, propylene glycol, or isopropanol) at specific weight ratios.

substeps.instruction: Prepare mixtures at surfactant:cosurfactant weight ratios of 1:2, 1:1, and 2:1.

steps.title: Mix Alpinia galangal oil (AGO) with Smix
steps.instruction: Combine Alpinia galangal oil (AGO) and the prepared Smix at various weight ratios (AGO:Smix).

substeps.instruction: Prepare mixtures at weight ratios of 0:1, 1:9, 2:8, 3:7, 4:6, 5:5, 6:4, 7:3, 8:2, 9:1, and 1:0.

steps.title: Titrate mixtures with distilled water
steps.instruction: Titrate the AGO:Smix mixtures with distilled water until an equilibrium end point of clarity is reached.

substeps.instruction: Record the volume of water used.
Determine and calculate the composition of each component at the equilibrium point as a weight percent.

steps.title: Construct pseudoternary phase diagrams
steps.instruction: Use OriginPro8 for Windows (OriginLab Corporation, USA) to construct the pseudoternary phase diagrams.

substeps.instruction: Plot the weight percent of Smix, AGO, and water for each equilibrium end point obtained from the titration step.
